messages:
Asha - MKTG: Heads up team — prepping assets for next week's Serving Wins rehearsal. Need a small asset bundle for the webinar run, the blog post, and demo decks. Core asks: hero visual for the landing page, a single slide with benchmark sparkline, a compact inbound routing diagram for ops, and three micro-explainers (cost, latency, quality). Target: first drafts by Tue noon.

Noah (Design): Clear. Which channel needs the hero first — landing or social? That changes composition. Also: do we prefer illustrative style or data-led diagram?

Asha - MKTG: Landing hero first (we'll crop for social). Prefer a hybrid: clear visual hierarchy with a schematic inset that highlights routing + caching. Keep assets modular for A/B.

Priya - Creative Ops: I created a starter file w/ grid components and export tokens: https://www.figma.com/file/yyyy/serve-wins-kits. Use comp set serve/win-tiles-v1. I've added placeholders for alt text and localization keys (EN/FR/DE).

Noah (Design): Thanks. Quick brand checks: which logo lockup? full horizontal or stacked mark? Also gif or static for the sparkline on the slide?

Kira - Brand: Use stacked mark for hero to preserve legibility on mobile. No shadows on logos. Sparkline: provide static SVG for slide and a short looping MP4 for social (we can convert to GIF later). Contrast must meet 4.5:1 for any small type.

Diego PMM: Micro-explainers should be targetted: 1) Developers — sample tokens/sec and latency benefit, 2) Platform/Enterprise — SLA + private deploy blurb, 3) Finance — cost/unit with batching note. Keep CTAs minimal: "Try the demo" / "Contact sales" / "Estimate cost".

Noah (Design): Draft export spec: hero 1400x800 (svg + 72dpi png), slide 1920x1080 (pptx + png), microtiles 560x560 (svg + png), routing-diagram 1100x800 (svg). I'll include alt text lines in Figma.

Priya - Creative Ops: Delivery checklist I'll attach to the Figma file. Exports: web PNG (72dpi), social square (1200x1200), slide PNG (1920x1080), print 300dpi (only if requested). Also ensure Figma frames are named with final filenames for batch export.

Asha - MKTG: File naming pattern: rdw_launchkit_<asset>_<audience>_v1. Example: rdw_launchkit_microtile_finance_v1.png. Diego — can you drop 1-line copy for each microtile (max 80 chars) by 16:00?

Diego PMM: On it — will post lines by 15:30.

Kira - Brand: One more note: any data charts must use the approved palette (see /brand/palettes/visual.csv). No rainbow gradients.

Noah (Design): Roger. I'll push the hero + routing diagram into Figma tonight and tag @Priya when frames are export-ready.

Figma Bot: Frame "serve-wins-hero-v1" created by Noah (Design) at 2026-03-25T02:12:05Z.

Priya - Creative Ops: When assets are in, I'll run quick accessibility checks and produce the handoff zip (pngs, svgs, alt_text.md, export_manifest.csv).

Asha - MKTG: Great — please ping #marketing-ops when the first pass is ready. We have a rehearsal Wed morning and need the slide PNG available before that. Thanks! :raised_hands:

Noah (Design): Will do — aiming for Tue evening push. :palette:
